messages:
nina (People Ops): Quick share: new compact template called 'Goal Evidence Ledger' to make self-reviews and manager feedback faster. Link: https://go.redwood/gel. Try it this cycle and tell us if it saves time.
omar (Eng): Nice. Is this replacing KR text or living alongside?
mei (PM): Alongside. Ledger is a short evidence log per KR. Helps reviewers see artifacts at a glance.
diego (Manager): Can we get sample phrasing managers can paste into comments?
nina (People Ops): Yes 8296 the doc includes micro-phrases under "Manager Notes":
- Positive: "Clear, dated artifact with link. Thanks 95 Can you add a one-line method note?"
- Clarify: "Good start; please attach the dashboard snippet or experiment ID."
- Development: "Strong signal; consider adding user-level examples to show customer impact."
omar (Eng): Any required fields? want to keep overhead low.
nina (People Ops): Required: evidence description, date, owner, artifact link, evidence type (metric/qual/incident), optional: methodology, customer impact. We recommend 1-3 rows per KR.
mei (PM): Cadence question: update live or at check-ins?
notifier-bot: Reminder: Mid-cycle check-ins open 2026-04-20. People Ops recommends ongoing updates; we'll snapshot at check-ins.
diego (Manager): I'll ask my directs to add one row per KR by next Monday.
nina (People Ops): Thanks! If any teams want a 10-min run-through, ping me and I'll join a sync. :thumbsup:
